第11章 以一敌五灵武境五阶（第1页）
叶瑶紧锁着眉头，注视着站在沐倾城左侧的青年，“没想到，他也是三位监察者之一……”
叶凡嘴里嘀咕，顺着叶瑶目光看向陈离，“就是之前给我送入学通知的那人？”
叶瑶压低声音，眼中满是担忧，“我建议，你还是别参加天武书院新生试炼了。”
陈离替段天涯给叶凡送入学通知，其中的关系不言自明。
新生试炼，天武书院导师和老学员都禁止进入狼园，唯独三位监察者例外。
“监察者，就能无视天武书院的规矩吗？”
叶凡挠了挠头，感觉还是低估了段天涯的手段。
陈离似也感受到叶凡的目光，扭头与叶凡对视，眼中透着一丝不屑与挑衅。
叶瑶低声回应，“可此事，我们不能赌……以他天榜前十的身份，即便事后被发现，也未必会受到多重的惩罚。”
走在人群最前头的沐坚，此时已停下脚步，目光扫过众人，朗声道，“狼园有三座真武塔，皆九层，凭天武令入。择其一，入塔激活手中天武令，视为通过试炼。为期十二个时辰，逾期未归者，剥夺入学资格。”
“进入真武塔不同楼层，决定尔等入天武书院后具体被分到哪一院，且可获得相应初始积分。另外提醒一点，狼园内学员之间不得自相残杀！现在，可以出发了。”
沐坚话落，沐倾城三人让到大门两侧。
人群随之而动，争先恐后冲入狼园。
叶凡见这场面，已按捺不住心中冲动，“要是连直面危险的勇气都没有，还怎么成为武道强者？我去了。”
虚空之上，三头青羽鹰缓缓降下身影。
沐倾城轻盈一跃，稳稳落在青羽鹰背上。

陈离眼中闪过一丝阴鸷，紧随其后。
另一位监察者古轶，则是默默跟上。
待青羽鹰腾空，陈离突然对沐倾城道，“我们可否换换？二区，我来监察。”
刚一答应，陈离乘青羽鹰疾驰而走。
沐倾城望着陈离远去，美眸闪烁不定。
近日，皇城那些消息传得沸沸扬扬。
陈离选择二区，只因叶凡进了二区。
叶凡穿梭于狼园密林中，发现身后一直有人跟着。
深入一段距离后，忽然停下了脚步。
缓缓转身，凝着目光望向来时的方向，“想玩是吧？那我就陪你们好好玩玩。”
片刻后，一行疾驰的身影缓了下来。

Ye Yao frowned and stared at the young man standing on the left side of Mu Qingcheng, "I didn't expect that he was also one of the three supervisors..."
Ye Fan muttered and followed Ye Yao's gaze to look at Chen Li, "Is this the person who sent me the admission notice before?"
Ye Yao lowered her voice, her eyes full of worry, "I suggest you not take part in the Tianwu Academy freshman trial."
Chen Li sent the admission notice to Ye Fan on behalf of Duan Tianya, and the relationship is self-evident.
During the freshman trial, Tianwu Academy instructors and veteran students were prohibited from entering the Wolf Park, with the exception of the three supervisors.
"Can supervisors ignore the rules of Tianwu Academy?"
Ye Fan scratched his head, feeling that he still underestimated Duan Tianya's methods.
Chen Li seemed to feel Ye Fan's gaze, and turned to look at Ye Fan, with a hint of disdain and provocation in his eyes.
Ye Yao responded in a low voice, "But we can't bet on this matter... With his status in the top ten of the Heavenly Ranking, even if he is discovered later, he may not be severely punished."
Mu Jian, who was walking at the front of the crowd, stopped now, glanced at the crowd, and said loudly, "There are three Zhenwu Towers in Langyuan, all with nine floors. You can enter with the Tianwu Order. Choose one of them, enter the tower and activate the Tianwu Order in your hand, and you will be deemed to have passed the trial. It lasts for twelve hours. Anyone who fails to return after the time limit will be deprived of admission qualifications."
"Entering different floors of Zhenwu Tower will determine which house you will be assigned to after entering Tianwu Academy, and you will receive corresponding initial points. Also, a reminder, students in the Wolf Park are not allowed to kill each other! Now, you can set off."
After Mu Jian finished speaking, Mu Qingcheng and the others moved to both sides of the gate.
The crowd moved accordingly, rushing into the wolf park.
Seeing this scene, Ye Fan couldn't hold back the impulse in his heart, "If you don't even have the courage to face danger, how can you become a strong martial artist? I'm going."
Above the void, three green-feathered eagles slowly descended.
Mu Qingcheng jumped lightly and landed firmly on the back of the blue-feathered eagle.
A hint of evil flashed in Chen Li's eyes, and he followed closely.
Another supervisor, Gu Yi, followed silently.
When the blue-feathered eagle took off, Chen Li suddenly said to Mu Qingcheng, "Can we switch? I'll monitor the second area."
As soon as he agreed, Chen Li galloped away on a blue-feathered eagle.
Mu Qingcheng watched Chen Li go away, her beautiful eyes flickering.
Recently, news about the Imperial City has spread a lot.
Chen Li chose the second district just because Ye Fan entered the second district.
Ye Fan shuttled through the dense forest of Wolf Park and found that there was someone following him.
After going some distance, he suddenly stopped.
He slowly turned around and stared in the direction he came from, "You want to play, right? Then I'll have a good time with you."
After a while, a group of speeding figures slowed down.
